company.name: The New Money Company
company.shortDescription: The New Money Company provides insured B2B invoicing and cross-border payment infrastructure for global trade.
company.description: The New Money Company provides a financial technology platform for insured B2B invoicing and cross-border enterprise payments. The company offers an order-to-cash backend that combines order management, invoicing, document collection, and structured invoice tracking. Its workflows include automated trade credit underwriting and insurance that can cover invoices against buyer nonpayment or fraud. The platform supports both a web app and developer APIs so teams can embed credit decisions and invoice protection into their own systems. The New Money Company also delivers multi-currency payment rails and virtual accounts to help businesses receive, hold, and send funds across markets. Its services are used by distributors, manufacturers, and other enterprises that extend net payment terms and transact with international buyers.
